Module org.kink_lang.kink
Package org.kink_lang.kink

Class NumVal

java.lang.Object
org.kink_lang.kink.HostResultCore
org.kink_lang.kink.Val
org.kink_lang.kink.NumVal
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<NumVal>, HostResult, Just<NumVal>, OpResult<NumVal>
public abstract sealed class NumVal extends Val implements Comparable<NumVal>, Just<NumVal>
A num value.

A num value consists of two integer attributes: Mantissa and Scale. The num value represents an decimal number (Mantissa * 10**(-Scale)). Kink runtimes must support at least the range [-(2^8192), (2^8192)-1] for Mantissa, and at least the range [0, 32767] for Scale.

In this implementation, a num value is backed by a Java BigDecimal. Mantissa is the “unscaled value” of BigDecimal, and Scale is the “scale” of BigDecimal.

    • intDivide

      public OpResult<NumVal> intDivide(NumVal divisor)
      Returns the integral quotient of this//divisor. If divisor is equal to 0, or overflow happens, the method returns OpError.

      Post conditions:

      • (this//divisor).scale == 0
      • this//divisor * divisor + this%divisor == this
      Parameters:
      divisor - the second operand.
      Returns:
      the integral quotient of this//divisor.

    • remainder

      public OpResult<NumVal> remainder(NumVal divisor)
      Returns the remainder of division of this by divisor. If divisor is equal to 0, or overflow happens, the method returns OpError.

      Post conditions:

      • (this%divisor).scale == max(this.scale, divisor.scale)
      • this//divisor * divisor + this%divisor == this
      Parameters:
      divisor - the second operand.
      Returns:
      the remainder of integral division of this by divisor.
